review_comment: The code performs a time-of-check time-of-use check by comparing file modification times. An attacker could manipulate file timestamps between the lstat() call and actual file operations, potentially bypassing safety checks. The vulnerability occurs at line 207 where st.mtime is compared against entry.mtime without atomicity guarantees. Add atomic file operations or synchronization to prevent race conditions.

The code performs a time-of-check (lstat) followed by time-of-use (file modification decision) with mtime comparison, creating a TOCTOU race condition. An attacker can manipulate file timestamps to bypass the newer file check. The patch introduces this vulnerability by adding the mtime comparison logic without synchronization. Implement atomic operations or proper locking mechanisms to prevent concurrent modification between check and use phases.
